name: LowCodePlatforms

sources.title: All Low Code Platforms directory homepage
Tool page showing the submit/boost contact instructions
TinyHunt listing describing free vs $49 paid submission
Category page showing submission response copy

conditions: Free submission: 'Approximately, we add new tools within three months' and the link is published as NO-FOLLOW
Paid option ($49 per third-party listings): immediate publication with a 'forever do-follow link'
requirements: Curated directory of low-code / no-code platforms, run by @johnrush (John Rush, MarsX)
Submission is via the 'Submit Platform' entry on the site; post-submit the site shows 'Our team will contact you soon' and routes paid boosts through direct contact with @johnrushx on X/Twitter
preparation: Platform name, URL, and short description
Willingness to wait ~3 months for a free nofollow listing, or $49 for immediate dofollow
For boosts: message @johnrushx including 'gpt url', the boost type and its price, and when you want it
workflow: Open https://lowcodeplatforms.org/ and use the 'Submit Platform' link in the nav
Fill the submission form with the platform's details
Await the 'Our team will contact you soon' response (~3 months for free, nofollow)
For paid: contact @johnrushx on X with your URL and desired boost type/price
watchFor: Free listings are explicitly NO-FOLLOW - unusual for directories marketed for SEO value
The $49 dofollow option is arranged manually via Twitter DM, not a checkout page
Directory also publishes blog content promoting John Rush's ListingBott service - expect related upsells
Listings observed include some off-topic entries (blogs, quizzes), so curation is loose
countsAsLive: The platform appears as a card on lowcodeplatforms.org under its category with a link to your site.
unknowns: Exact submit form fields and URL (form endpoint not isolated in fetches)
Whether the $49 paid path is still current or price has changed
